notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Typingvania has received a very warm welcome since its release. Thank you! Please leave a review if you haven't — it really helps.



Here's what changed in update v1.2:



Fixed an issue where words containing the focus character would not be scheduled, making it impossible to progress

Added Brazilian Portuguese UI language

Added “English (no tone marks)” input option to 《红楼梦》 (Simplified Chinese) to better match native typing
